query: My deployment is failing — here is the URL: https://console.qovery.com/organization/x/project/y/environment/z/service/s/deployment-logs
expected_behavior: Extracts orgId, projectId, envId, serviceId from the URL
Recognizes the `deployment-logs` page suffix as a hint and fetches /environment/{envId}/logs (V2 deployment logs)
Walks the 8-layer diagnosis from reference/phase2-8-layer-diagnosis.md until the failing layer is identified
Loads the matching playbook from reference/phase3-playbooks.md (e.g. health-check, OOM, port mismatch)
Proposes a fix and asks for confirmation before applying it via PUT /application/{appId}

query: My app is in CrashLoopBackOff — out of memory I think
expected_behavior: Pulls recent logs via `qovery log --service` and confirms the OOMKilled signal
Checks the current memory allocation via GET /application/{appId} and compares with observed peak usage
Recommends a memory increase with a justified target (not arbitrary), or recommends finding a memory leak if usage is grossly disproportionate
Generates a runbook entry via reference/phase6-runbook.md once the issue is fixed

query: Connection refused when my backend tries to reach the Postgres database
expected_behavior: Verifies the database is in DEPLOYED state via /environment/{envId}/statuses
Checks that the backend uses the alias / interpolated DATABASE_URL pointing at QOVERY_DATABASE_..._CONNECTION_URI_INTERNAL, not an external hostname
Looks for missing or unaliased env vars on the backend
If accessibility is wrong, recommends switching the database to PRIVATE (intra-cluster only)
Optionally runs `qovery port-forward` against the database to validate it is reachable from the cluster
